text.homoglyphRepair: Latin look-alikes inside Cyrillic words are restored before transliteration; without it the same station splits in two

waterYear: air temperature, precipitation and the Pedya index are delivered October to September; the row label is the water year and the calendar year is derived

emptyVariables.pedya_index: delivered as a header block in all 69 station sheets and empty in every one; parsed and found to hold no values rather than silently dropped

qualityNotes: Suspect values are flagged, never deleted: quality carries ok, out-of-range or outlier-station-month and the value stays readable.
The outlier test compares a value with its own station and calendar month, so a cold January is not judged against July.
Coordinates come from the gauge registries only; meteorological and soil stations arrive without them and are published without invented positions.
